trivia_fact: As of 2024, GCP has around 40 regions compared to AWS's 30+ and Azure's 60+. Google focused on strategic placements near major internet exchanges and its private fiber backbone rather than raw region count.

Google owns or co-owns multiple submarine fiber optic cables (Grace Hopper, Curie, Dunant, Equiano) and operates one of the world's largest private networks. GCP traffic between regions often never touches the public internet.
